PLAN "12-Week Cardiac-Safe Strength and Conditioning + Nutrition (5K Build with Compounds) - Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase muscular strength safely at moderate intensity with compound lifts"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Cardiac-focused heart-healthy nutrition"
  GOAL tertiary endurance:
    name "Prepare for a cardiac-safe 5K time trial at moderate effort"

          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Base aerobic + core":

          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m rpe 6
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body B":

NOTES
  - Compound lifts included: squat, front_squat, trap_bar_deadlift. Prescribed conservatively (moderate RPE 6..7, controlled sets, longer rests) to avoid Valsalva and excessive cardiovascular strain.
  - Maintain heart rate <70% age-predicted max (~115 bpm). If HR approaches limit or symptoms occur (chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness, palpitations), stop and seek medical advice.
  - Running sessions are set to moderate RPE 6..7; substitute with brisk walking or cycling when necessary to keep HR within target.
  - Nutrition plan emphasizes Mediterranean-style, reduced sodium, adequate protein, fiber, and pre-race fueling guidance.
